defect_inventory_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2G-R - Defect and Vulnerability Inventory
defect_inventory_metadata.auditor_role: Principal Quantitative Systems & Adversarial Regression Auditor

defects_evaluated.title: Absence of Streaming Causal Event Handling and Silent Batch Re-sorting
defects_evaluated.description: In Stage 2G dry runner, synthetic bars were collected and pre-processed in batch before simulation. In Scenario 18, out-of-order injection was omitted. In a prospective streaming or real-time context, if an observation arrives late (exchange_ts < current_watermark), pre-sorting the bar stream retroactively mutates past market states presented to decide(), violating causal immutability.
defects_evaluated.reproduction_evidence: Inspection of research/engine/v30_stage2g_synthetic_dry_runner.py lines 242-255 demonstrates batch preprocessing ('sanitized_bars[sym] = clean_list') and lack of late-event watermark buffering in streaming ingestion.

defects_evaluated.title: Unqualified M=1 Prospective Claim and Over-Reliance on Path-Dependent MDD
defects_evaluated.description: Stage 2G preregistration declared M=1 without qualifying that Candidate D2 was selected after testing >= 43 historical strategy candidates (C1-C4, D1-D3, P1-P4, etc.), creating unacknowledged selection bias. Furthermore, relying on single-value end-of-period MDD as the primary hypothesis test lacks statistical power and fails to model paired daily downside shortfall with proper serial correlation adjustments.
defects_evaluated.reproduction_evidence: Stage 2G report Section 9 and v30_stage2g_scientific_evaluation_preregistration.json line 50 state 'M=1, zero hyperparameter tuning' without documenting historical candidate selection bias. Primary endpoint was specified as raw full-window MDD delta without daily paired shortfall decomposition.

defects_evaluated.title: Over-Restrictive Requirement for Institutional License in Private Research
defects_evaluated.description: Stage 2G certification report stated that activation strictly requires human repository owner procurement of an 'institutional market data subscription'. Under copyright and terms of service jurisprudence, personal/developer-tier subscriptions from authorized providers (e.g. Tiingo Personal, Alpaca Paper/Market Data, Polygon Starter, Interactive Brokers) legally permit private internal research, non-commercial simulation, and local quantitative analysis.
defects_evaluated.reproduction_evidence: Stage 2G report Section 1 and Section 8 stated activation requires 'procurement of an authorized institutional market data subscription'. A provider-neutral classification distinguishes private research rights from commercial SaaS redistribution rights.

defects_evaluated.title: Absence of Cryptographic Fail-Closed Activation Gatekeeper
defects_evaluated.description: While strategy code is air-gapped and lacks network/broker code, the repository lacked an explicit programmatically enforced gatekeeper to distinguish OFFLINE_SYNTHETIC mode from prospective paper evaluation, allowing accidental execution if external feeds were introduced without signed human authorization.
defects_evaluated.reproduction_evidence: Repository contains no active gatekeeper verifying a signed Owner Authorization Token prior to executing forward-looking paper runners.
